name: pi-local-server
description: Pi extension that auto-discovers local LLM servers (llama.cpp, LM Studio, Strata, Ollama, vLLM, SGLang...) on this machine, your LAN and Tailscale, and registers each as a Pi provider with its real, always-current context window.
